notes:
Passed on the fake backend by python3 -m mhs.driver check (evidence contract_checked, never an MHS-Device level). The package binds the card's first entry symbol, LowLevelModules.Instruments:DG645, a text-SCPI digital delay generator; the card's reads/writes hints are its methods and the family-config ScpiDriver expresses those lines without changing their syntax. No DEVIATION FROM THE CARD. The clone states no numeric bound for any DG645 setting, so all twelve writable fields are Limit.operator_required; site-limits.example.json fills them with example deployment bounds and a bare driver refuses every write with MHS.SAFETY.LIMITS_UNSET. Safety: the e-stop writes LPOL 1,1 through LPOL 4,1, the notebook's positive polarity/default LOW state for its laser channels; this is a software command to the delay generator, not a hardware emergency stop. NOT COVERED: outputs 2-4 for LAMP/LOFF/LPOL, delay channels 2-9, and the SG384, LakeShore335, GaussMeter475, ConexCC and ConexAGP classes of the repository; the card's action hints for SG384/Conex are outside this DG645 package. The fake is a stateful in-memory SCPI transport because the clone has no simulator or recording; every start value is test data marked # placeholder. Model-authored and unreviewed; no hardware backend was run and no hardware run is claimed. gate.digest is the digest the last check printed; check-report.json is regenerated by every gate run and is not part of the package.
